events.title: Badlands Gravel Battle
events.description:
If you like riding on Badlands singletrack, you will love grinding Badlands gravel! All of the same gorgeous North Dakota scenery you see on the Maah Daah Hey trail, but with the freedom of wide, open, red scoria gravel roads. Put this gravel grinder on the bucket list!

Google Map of the BGB RACECOURSE!

events.title: Bold St. Nick'S Fatbike Race
events.description:
BE BOLD, BRAVE THE COLD AT THE 11th ANNUAL WINTER FATBIKE RACE IN THE NORTH DAKOTA BADLANDS. WHETHER YOU’RE ON BOLD ST. NICK’S NAUGHTY LIST OR NICE LIST, YOU WILL EXPERIENCE THE WORLD-FAMOUS MAAH DAAH HEY LIKE FEW BIKERS HAVE… FROZEN!

Racers on the NICE LIST will enjoy the fun and challenging course for 2 hours. Those on the NAUGHTY LIST will be punished for 4 grueling hours. Riders who want to work together as a group can sign up for the REINDEER TEAM OPTION: teams of 2 or more will send out one rider on course, at a time, while the others stay warm and cozy by the outside fire pit or in their warming house.

events.title: Maah Daah Hey 100 Mtb Race(S)
events.description:
ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST HAVE THEIR OWN TRANSPORTATION TO THE RACE STARTING LINE, AND THEIR OWN TRANSPORTATION OFF THE RACE COURSE IF THEY ARE UNABLE TO MAKE IT TO THE FINISH LINE... this event is in the middle of nowhere, Badlands USA... there is NO UBER or LYFT or taxis. We highly recommend bringing friends and/or family to be your SUPPORT AND GEAR (SAG) CREW. It is the safest and funnest way to eXperience the race.

***FRIDAY - PACKET PICKUP

All racers must check in at Packet Pickup the night before the race. We host packet pickup at two locations: MDH100 and MDH75 participants must pick up their packets in Watford City; MDH50, MDH25, and MDH13 participants must pick up their packets in Medora.

5pm –7pm Packet Pickup at the Roosevelt Inn & Suites (600 2nd Ave SW Watford City, ND 58854)

5pm – 7pm Packet Pickup at Finish Line Headquarters (Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library) 3410 Chateau Rd, Medora, ND 58645

THE MDH100 IS DESIGNED TO BE EPICALLY CHALLENGING AND IMPOSSIBLY FUN... We will have the trail in the best shape possible and fully marked!

THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING OUR TRAIL WORK EFFORTS. YOU CAN FIND MORE INFO AND SHOP OUR STORE AT WWW.SAVETHEMDH.COM

NO REFUNDS... no matter what! The Badlands Race Series is unable to provide any reimbursements forany reason, any and all requests will be denied. HOWEVER, racers may purchase event insurance from RunSignUp.

events.title: Maah Daah Hey Trail Run(S)
events.description: WITH 6 OPTIONS: 5K, 10K, HALF & FULL MARATHONS, and 2 Ultra Options... 56 and 107 miles... We are the premier TRAIL RUNNING experience in the ND Badlands. Our trail run offers something for runners of all levels, from first-timers to the seasoned ultra runners. EVERY race distance is on the world-famous Maah Daah Hey Trail giving you some of the most stunning scenery you will see anywhere. EVERY race distance is a point-to-point giving you a real adventure with new beautiful views around every rugged corner. EVERY race distance ends in the romantically quaint little cowboy town of Medora, ND giving your fan club a fun experience and lots to do while they await your grand crossing at the finish line. This is the only trail run on the Maah Daah Hey you will ever need to do…

events.title: Santa Fun Run
events.description:
Bring your holiday cheer to Reynolds on December 6th for the 11th Annual Santa Fun Run! The Sidney Run Club is teaming up with Reynolds and High Caliber Sports for another festive fun run during the annual Christmas Classic! There will be both a 5k course as well as a 1 mile route for families!

Run as Santa himself, one of his many Elves, or maybe in an ugly sweater! The real Santa and Mrs. Claus will be there to kick off the run!

A portion of the proceeds from the run benefit the local Christmas Coalition. The Richland County Christmas Coalition "Gifts from the Heart" event is an annual gift distribution to those in need in the community. Recipients are allowed to choose gifts for a child that resides full time in their home and under the age of 18. We have been incredibly grateful to donate over $1000 the last couple years!
